description:
Build an intuitive mental model of core data structures and algorithms using relatable, real-world analogies. Topics range from arrays and hash maps to trees, graphs, and dynamic programming. Once you grasp the underlying logic and problem-solving mechanics covered here, implementing them in any programming language becomes easy.
